title: Nourishing Silky Ukrainian Beet Pilaf
description: A pungent and silky post-workout Ukrainian dish featuring pul biber, this pilaf is made with katsuramuki-cut beets and is dairy-free friendly, served in a ramekin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the katsuramuki-cut beets and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the pul biber, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Transfer the mixture to a ramekin and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the pilaf from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
